run_gather_metadata: run the script with --data-dir and --tgt-dir to gather metadata from *extra.pt files into train/test splits
run_split_dps: run split_dps to split datapoints into train and test sets and dump them as JSON and HDF5 files
run_extract_scene_name: run extract_scene_name to parse a file path and return the scene name for scannet, gibson, or mp3d datasets
run_tuple_n_general_new: run tuple_n_general_new to collect metadata from *extra.pt files, extract scene info, and split into train/test HDF5
review_split_dps: review split_dps to understand how datapoints are split into train/test and serialized to JSON samples and compressed HDF5
